acceptance_criteria: Empresa catalog and relationship candidates discovered

queries.name: api_local_connections_missing_empresa_id
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 100 CONVERT(nvarchar(100), id) AS connection_id, nombre, system_type, tipo_conexion, activo, visible_en_operaciones, visible_en_listado, empresa_id, TRY_CONVERT(int, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(empresa_id)), '')) AS empresa_id_int FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones WHERE tipo_conexion = 'API_LOCAL' ORDER BY nombre

queries.name: empresa_candidate_tables
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Empresa%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Compania%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%UnidadNegocio%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Sucursal%' ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME

queries.name: empresa_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, ORDINAL_POSITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Empresa%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Compania%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%UnidadNegocio%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Sucursal%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Empresa%' OR COLUMN_NAME IN ('EmpresaID', 'id_empresa', 'Nombre', 'NombreComercial', 'RazonSocial', 'RFC', 'Codigo', 'Activo') ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: specific_relation_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, ORDINAL_POSITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('Sistema_EmpresasServidores', 'Sistema_Empresas', 'Empresa_Catalogo', 'Empresas', 'Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion', 'Usuario_RolesContexto', 'Usuario_ServidoresAsignacion', 'Servidores_Conexiones') ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: active_user_empresa_scope_distribution
queries.sql: SELECT EmpresaID, COUNT(DISTINCT UsuarioID) AS usuarios_con_alcance FROM dbo.Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion WHERE Activo = 1 GROUP BY EmpresaID ORDER BY EmpresaID

queries.name: active_role_context_empresa_distribution
queries.sql: SELECT EmpresaID, COUNT(DISTINCT UsuarioID) AS usuarios_con_contexto, COUNT(DISTINCT RolID) AS roles_distintos FROM dbo.Usuario_RolesContexto WHERE Activo = 1 AND EmpresaID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EmpresaID ORDER BY EmpresaID

queries.name: server_assignment_distribution
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(nvarchar(100), ServidorID) AS servidor_id, COUNT(DISTINCT UsuarioID) AS usuarios_asignados FROM dbo.Usuario_ServidoresAsignacion WHERE Activo = 1 GROUP BY ServidorID ORDER BY servidor_id

objective: Discover canonical Empresa catalog and Empresa-to-Servidor relationship needed to populate dbo.Servidores_Conexiones.empresa_id for API_LOCAL connections. No DML, no connectivity test.
